s: puM, (samyak PAlo gamanaM yasya .) mezaH । iti hemacandraH ॥
v: pu॰ sam + Pala--jvalA॰ Ra । meDe hemaca॰ ।
m: सम्-फाल m. a ram, sheep, L.
सम्-फल mf(आ)n. (√ फल्) rich in fruit or seed, fruitful, Pāṇ. iv, 1, 64, Vārtt. 2, Pat.

सम्-फेट m. (prob. for सं-स्फेट, q.v.) mutual conflict or encounter of angry persons, angry or passionate contention (in dram. one of the 13 elements of the विमर्श [q.v.], illustrated by the altercation between Śakuntalā and the king in Śak.; or as one of the 4 elements of the आरभटि [q.v.], illustrated by the encounter of Mādhava and Aghora-ghaṇṭa in Mālatīm.), Bhar.; Daśar.; Sāh.

s: tri, (saM + Pala + ktaH । “utPullasaMPullayoriti vaktavyam .” 8 । 2 । 55 । ityasya vArttikoktyA nipAtitaH .) vikasitaH । praPullaH । ityamaraH । 2 । 4 । 7 ॥
v: tri॰ sama + Pulla--ac । vikasite । sam + Pala--kta ata uttvam । sampulta iti lakAramaDyo'pi tatrEva ।
m: सम्-फुल्ल mfn. full-blown, blossomed, fully opened or expanded (as a flower), Kāv.; Rājat.
